name: Raguel
source:
[i]"I've come to get my wife-to-be."[/i]

Raguel is a "Babilom" who shares the exact same unique supernatural powers as the protagonist. His primary power is mind control, which he uses to hypnotize the protagonist into forgetting everyone. His goal is to force her into marriage so that their superpowers will live on.
